_note: Retention messages (App Store Connect, shown when a subscriber starts to cancel). Header <= 66 chars, body <= 144 chars (ASC API limits). No prices, discounts, offers or trial wording: App Review rejects them. Plan: .claude/3.1.9-retention-messages.md

en-GB: Your journal stays yours, whatever you choose
Without Core, you keep writing, search, iCloud backup and every reflection already made. New daily reflections, Ask and weekly digests stop.
en-US: Your journal stays yours, whatever you choose
Without Core, you keep writing, search, iCloud backup and every reflection already made. New daily reflections, Ask and weekly digests stop.

Sin Core conservas la escritura, la búsqueda, la copia en iCloud y tus reflexiones. Se acaban las nuevas reflexiones, Preguntar y los resúmenes.

it: Il tuo diario resta tuo, qualunque cosa tu scelga
Senza Core conservi scrittura, ricerca, backup iCloud e ogni riflessione già creata. Si fermano le nuove riflessioni, Chiedi e i riepiloghi.
ja: どれを選んでも、日記はずっとあなたのものです
Coreがなくても、書く・検索・iCloudバックアップ、これまでの振り返りはそのまま。新しい毎日の振り返り・質問・週間ダイジェストは止まります。
ko: 어떤 선택을 하든 일기는 언제나 당신의 것입니다

pt-BR: Seu diário continua seu, seja qual for sua escolha
Sem o Core, você mantém a escrita, a busca, o backup no iCloud e cada reflexão já feita. Param as novas reflexões, Perguntar e os resumos.
ru: Ваш дневник остаётся вашим, что бы вы ни выбрали
Без Core вы можете писать, искать, хранить копию в iCloud, а созданные размышления остаются. Новые размышления, вопросы и сводки прекратятся.
